messages:
Sienna Tran: Hey all 44b Im Sienna, joining Growth today. Quick setup Qs: who do I bug for laptop shipping, MDM enrollment and Slack channel perms? Also curious what snacks people actually devour. Fun fact: Im into bouldering and make terrible puns.

Noah (IT): Welcome Sienna! Open a ticket at it.redwood/team and tag me. If you want a mac, say M1 or M2; otherwise we can provision Ubuntu. Once you get the laptop run `sudo company-setup` (youll get the script attached to the ticket).

Jen (People Ops): Hi Sienna 970 Ive started your onboarding form and scheduled the welcome kit. Kits include stickers, a hoodie size option, and a ramen bowl. Shipping ETA 2 business days if youre in the US. Reply with hoodie size + device pref.

Cora Li: hey! Im Cora, your onboarding buddy from Growth Ops. Ill do a 2pm walk-through today to show repos, docs, and our ticket flow. Ill add you to #growth and #snacks now. Salty wins over sweet in our office60b

Alex Gomez: Welcome aboard! We usually do lunch on Fridays (ramen or tacos). Also the Growth first-week checklist is in the handbook under Onboarding > Teams > Growth. Ping me if anything missing.

BuddyBot: Automated: Device enrollment link https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll. After enrolling, request VPN in the IT ticket. If enrollment fails include `sysdiag.log`.

Sienna Tran: Thanks everyone 60a Hoodie = M. Mac M2 would be lovely. Ill open the IT ticket now and attach my personal email for provisioning. Excited to meet you all and try the office chips :potato:
